# Spring Facilities Summit 2027: acceptance letter (for the 8 accepted proposals; Ben merges names and titles in Oxford Abstracts)

Subject: Accepted: your session at the Spring Facilities Summit, April 13-14, 2027

Congratulations: the program committee has accepted your proposal for the GLSFE Spring Facilities Summit, Tuesday-Wednesday, April 13-14, 2027, at The Lennox Hotel Columbus. Out of 46 proposals, yours is one of 8 selected.

- Your session: 60 minutes, about 45 of presentation and 15 of discussion, so attendees earn 1.0 PDH. We'll confirm the day and time by December 18.
- Complimentary registration for the lead presenter; co-presenters register at the member rate.
- Please confirm by Friday, November 20 by signing the speaker agreement we'll send by DocuSign, and complete the speaker form (bio, three learning objectives) by Friday, December 4.
- Slides are due Monday, March 29, 2027, two weeks before the Summit.
- Sessions are educational: no product promotion or pricing in the presentation.
- Hotel: the GLSFE group rate of $179 at the Lennox; booking link with your agreement. Travel is at your own expense.

Questions: Harper Quinn, Senior Events Manager, 734-555-0160. Thank you for sharing your work with our members.
Frank Delgado, PE, Program Chair, and the Spring Summit program committee
